sentences.text: Her eyes are rimmed with red, and they never stop watching.
Everyone sees a harmless old woman in a bonnet.
Her mouth twists into a sly grin.
And her red eyes slide to the side.
Théodore Géricault painted her as one of ten portraits of the insane.
Only five of them survive today.
So why would a famous painter sit with madness?
The answer is in her nickname.
She is also called the Hyena of the Salpêtrière.
Géricault painted patients of that Paris asylum.
He also studied the heads of guillotine victims.
So is she just old and tired, or still watching you with envy?

meta.title: The Old Woman Who Was Called the HYENA #history #art
meta.description: Monomaniac of Envy is one of ten portraits of the insane that Théodore Géricault painted of patients of Paris hospitals; only five survive. It is also known as the Hyena of the Salpêtrière and hangs in the Museum of Fine Arts of Lyon.
